detections.diagnosis: Localized opaque bird dropping obstructing active cells, inducing reverse-bias hot spots.
detections.recommended_action: Targeted spot wash with soft brush and demineralized water. Check for hot-spot reverse bias heating.
detections.estimated_impact: 15% to 25% local power drop, accelerated local aging.

maintenance_info.diagnosis: Localized opaque bird dropping obstructing active cells, inducing reverse-bias hot spots.
maintenance_info.recommended_action: Targeted spot wash with soft brush and demineralized water. Check for hot-spot reverse bias heating.
sop: 1. Pre-soak soiled surface with demineralized water (resist chemicals).
2. Wipe gently with non-abrasive microfiber wand.
3. Inspect underlying cell for localized thermal discoloration.
4. Verify string power recovery after drying.
maintenance_info.estimated_impact: 15% to 25% local power drop, accelerated local aging.
